title: How to Find Product Market Fit - Stanford CS183F: Startup School
summary: Segment co-founder and CEO Peter Reinhardt recounts how his company found product-market fit, including how a product grew out of a small feature of another. It is a lecture from Stanford's Startup School course.
why: HN founders recommend it as a must-watch on recognizing real product-market fit and avoiding solutions in search of problems.

quote.text: Peter Reinhardt from Segment has a must-watch talk for anyone interested in this topic
